lines.text: Job says his grief outweighs the sand of the seas, and the Almighty's arrows have pierced him.
Job says his brothers are faithless like wadis, and the caravans of Moab and Edom look for water.

wrong_details.wrong: the caravans of Moab and Edom
wrong_details.true: the caravans of Tema and Sheba

lines.text: Job asks his friends to teach him how he has erred, and he says honest words are painful.
Job says he has been given months of futility, tosses and turns until dawn, and his days end without honor.

wrong_details.true: his days come to an end without hope

lines.text: Job asks God why He keeps him under guard, frightens him with dreams, and does not pardon his transgression.
